label: enemies
description: 6 aquatic enemy types, 4 animation frames each
original_prompt: Generate a sprite sheet of retro arcade space-invasion enemy sprites for a Galaga-style game, but with an AQUATIC / deep-sea alien theme. LAYOUT: 6 rows x 4 columns on a solid pure black background. Each row is one unique aquatic enemy; the 4 columns in that row are its 4 animation frames shown left-to-right. All cells exactly the same size (256x256 px), evenly spaced, no text, no labels, no borders between cells. Square image 1024 wide x 1536 tall. STYLE: crisp 16-bit neo-arcade pixel art, underwater bioluminescent neon colors (cyan, teal, magenta, poison-green, orange) glowing against dark abyss-black. Sharp hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO gradients, flat shading with one highlight + one shadow step, high contrast, symmetrical, front-facing, no perspective. Consistent style across every sprite. Each enemy centered in its cell with consistent scale. Add glowing accent cores/eyes. 1px dark rim outline so sprites pop off black. ROWS (top to bottom), 4 distinct loopable frames each: 1. Pufferfish (spiky round fish) - puff cycle: small -> mid -> big with spikes out -> mid 2. Flying Mantis Crab (hovering crustacean with big pincers) - pincers: open -> closing -> snap shut -> opening 3. Jellyfish (dome with trailing tentacles) - tentacle sway: phase 1 -> 2 -> 3 -> 4 4. Anglerfish (dark fish with glowing lure on stalk and big toothy jaw) - jaw: open -> biting -> closed -> lure flicker 5. Mech-Shark / Orca (sleek armored fast diver) - fin flick + mouth open/close cycle, 4 poses 6. Sea Dragon (horned serpent-like beast with small tentacles) - tentacle wave + horn glow pulse, 4 phases. Frames within each row must be clearly distinct but smoothly sequential (loopable). Keep it clean and croppable.
